# WE DO Interior Design & Fit-Out

> WE DO Interior Design & Fit-Out is a Dubai-based interior design and turnkey fit-out company with 15+ years of experience and 250+ completed residential and commercial projects across Dubai. ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified, and named Luxury Style Awards Winner 2026, WE DO delivers every project entirely in-house.

WE DO runs its own interior design, civil works, decoration and joinery teams — backed by a state-of-the-art in-house joinery factory and a dedicated team handling DCD, Dubai Municipality (DM) and private developer approvals including Emaar and Damac, giving clients a single point of responsibility from concept through handover.

## About
- About Us: https://wedointerior.ae/about-us — Learn about WE DO's experience, certifications, in-house teams and turnkey delivery model.

## Process
1. Free consultation and site visit.
2. Space planning and concept development.
3. 3D visualization and material selection.
4. Detailed quotation and project planning.
5. Authority approvals (where required).
6. In-house execution including civil works, MEP and joinery.
7. Final inspection and project handover.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- How do I find the best interior design company in Dubai? Compare licensing, certifications, completed projects, portfolio quality, in-house capabilities and approval experience before deciding.
- How much does interior design cost in Dubai? Pricing depends on property size, scope, materials and finish level. Quotes are prepared individually.
- How do I choose an interior design company? Review credentials, portfolio, approvals capability, project management process and whether design and execution are handled by one company.
- Does WE DO provide turnkey interior design and fit-out? Yes. Projects are delivered from concept through handover.
- Does WE DO have its own joinery factory? Yes. Custom joinery and furniture are produced in-house.
- Does WE DO handle approvals? Yes. The team manages approvals with DM, DCD and major developers where applicable.
- Does WE DO provide 3D visualization? Yes.
- Does WE DO work outside Dubai? WE DO primarily serves clients across Dubai. Contact the team regarding projects outside Dubai.
- What is the difference between an interior designer and a fit-out contractor? Designers develop the concept while fit-out contractors execute construction; WE DO provides both under one contract.
